endpoints.truth_yaml:
post:
  operationId: copySchedulingAssignment
  summary: Copy a scheduling assignment
  x-verification-status: UNCONFIRMED-AGREE
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-030000-post.workspaces.scheduling.assignments.copy-happy-path.json
  x-notes: |
    GET /.../{assignmentId}/copy returns 405 (Spring-MVC: path registered, wrong method).
    POST /.../{assignmentId}/copy with empty body returns 400 'must not be null' (path exists,
    requires valid payload). No typed tool in GOCLMCP implements this path. Raw writes blocked
    so full live success cannot be demonstrated. Status is UNCONFIRMED-AGREE (stronger than bare
    405 due to 400 from POST confirming path is active).
  x-truth-iter: iter19
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
    - name: assignmentId
      in: path
      required: true
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Copied assignment
endpoints.notes: GET returns 405, POST returns 400 (not 404), confirming endpoint exists on live Clockify. No GOCLMCP typed tool covers this path. Cannot achieve LIVE-VERIFIED because raw writes are blocked.

discrepancies.openapi_claim: POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/scheduling/assignments/users/totals exists (source: ours only in TRUTH.openapi.yaml)
discrepancies.live_reality: Both GET and POST return 404 'No static resource' — path is not registered on live Clockify
discrepancies.goclmcp_impact: GOCLMCP does not use this path. Multi-user totals is served by POST /user-filter/totals (LIVE-VERIFIED). Single-user capacity uses GET /users/{userId}/totals.
discrepancies.action: Remove this endpoint from OpenAPI spec. Replace with post.workspaces.scheduling.assignments.user-filter.totals which is the correct live path.
